gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: In 2023, Syndicate 1618 experienced a net strengthening of prior year reserves by $17.2 million, representing 3.8% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by increased loss estimates for Winter Storm Elliott (2022) and Hurricane Ida (2021), and strengthening of 2021 attritional year of account reserves. These adverse developments were partly offset by favourable reductions in estimates for Hurricane Ian (2022) and the 2022 Australian floods. The Syndicate also reported major losses from 2023 events, including Hawaiian wildfires and Hurricane Idalia, with a combined net impact of $20.0 million. The report also details various modelled catastrophe scenarios (RDS events) for risk management purposes.
